title: ARC active plan pointer
description: plans/current.json - the manifest naming the active snapshot. Written ONLY by /arc-publish-plan, via write-temp plus rename. The same field set, scoped to one snapshot, is reused verbatim as plans/<plan-id>/manifest.json.

planId.description: Directory name under plans/ holding the active snapshot.

planHash.description: SHA-256 of plan.json bytes exactly as written. Every worker re-verifies this before acting (W-V3).

ref.description: Commit SHA the snapshot was published against.

publishedBy.description: Owner identity recorded at publish time. Advisory provenance, not an authorization token.

supersedesPlanId.description: The planId this snapshot replaced, or null for the first publication.

staleSourceAcknowledged.description: true when the owner overrode P-V14 because CHECKPOINT.md was newer than the source artifact.

refMismatchAcknowledged.description: true when the owner overrode P-V10.

carriedOverClaims.description: Claims that were live against supersedesPlanId at publication. Recorded for audit ONLY. Publication never rewrites a live claim - silently retargeting one would be stale-claim stealing under another name.
